notebook.author: ChatGPT (via task brief)
notebook.body: Scope: sporadic beach finds gradually exposed by simulated wave erosion; buoyant items wash out, drift and wash ashore; ship-origin and player-discarded debris; shared currents, wind/tides and unanchored boat drift; natural convergence hotspots with redistribution and regional caps to avoid trash-filled harbors; configurable spawn rates, item lifetimes and save/session persistence to evaluate. Use lightweight distant records and nearby physics, not full sand simulation. Evaluate simulated curved horizon with peaks appearing before beaches and greater visibility from elevated viewpoints/crow's nests. Game-spawned messages in bottles can drift and activate dynamic quests on reading, including treasure maps and digging at valid locations, rescue, smuggling, wrecks, traps and lore. Persist activated quest state, prevent duplicate rewards, protect critical items, favor landmark-based navigation. Require gameplay balance and performance testing.
